name: Rowan

biography.name: Rowan

background.family: Lives with parents and an older sibling.
background.finances: Moderate income; occasional clothing purchases are planned.
background.cultureLanguages: English and Spanish within the family.
background.school: Public high school with art and career exploration events.
background.accessOpportunities: Style sketches and one supervised mannequin demonstration; no paid services.

timeline.story: In 2014, Rowan liked dressing paper figures and inventing where each was going that day. They also enjoyed large outdoor games, often changing clothes in the story more frequently than changing the actual game they played.

At six, they began drawing family members in imagined outfits. During 2017, a cousin pointed out that a favorite sketch did not resemble what the cousin wanted, teaching Rowan to ask before assuming a personal preference was universal.

In 2018, Rowan joined a school art group and enjoyed planning colors and shapes. Science experiments and keeping office-style lists held less interest, although they completed the required assignments and occasionally liked an unexpected topic.

During 2020, Rowan collected hairstyle references and sketched possibilities for fictional characters. They enjoyed listening when relatives described what felt comfortable, learning that a style could look appealing in a picture and still fail someone’s everyday routine.

At twelve, Rowan began asking more specific questions before sketching a style for someone. In 2023, a school exploration event introduced the idea of licensed salon training, which sounded worth investigating rather than like a settled decision.

Across 2024 and 2025, Rowan tried a careful technique on a mannequin under supervision and helped organize demonstration tools. They enjoyed the welcoming setting but had never provided a paid salon service or learned how demanding customer situations were handled.

At sixteen in 2026, Rowan is comparing Texas licensed training information and introductory visits. They like spending some money on clothing, but want a realistic view of customer work, practice requirements, and the difference between visual interest and a longer training commitment.

ambitions: Explore licensed training and customer settings
They imagine a friendly adult routine with a comfortable home, personal style, and close social connections.
struggles: May assume a welcoming event reflects all workdays
